pricing_self_hosted.confidence: M (self-hosted-pricing 404 on the URL pattern; structure inferred from docs)

community.g2_reviews_count: Not explicitly disclosed in search snapshots; estimated ~200-400 (community open-source skews lower than enterprise SaaS)
g2_top_cons: AI automation less advanced (pre-Captain era reviews)

governance_compliance.soc2_certified: Cloud edition: yes (typical for SaaS at this maturity); not explicit in search
governance_compliance.gdpr_compliance: Yes (DPA, EU data residency optional via self-hosted in EU region)

governance_compliance.confidence: M (compliance posture lighter than Zendesk; self-hosted is escape valve for regulated)

support_sla.enterprise_support: Dedicated CSM at $99/agent/mo or self-hosted Enterprise paid contract
